 Open Navigation Menu Menu Search Search News Charli XCX Will Appear in a Martin Scorsese Film
 She reportedly makes a cameo in What Happens At Night with Leonardo DiCaprio and Jennifer Lawrence By Hattie Lindert October 22, 2026 Charli XCX and Martin Scorsese (Getty Images) Comment Loader Save Story Save this story Comment Loader Save Story Save this story When Charli XCX revealed the cover for Music, Fashion, Film , it boasted three heavyweights from each discipline: John Cale , Marc Jacobs, and Martin Scorsese. Now, the pop star and the director have reunited for Scorsese’s next movie, What Happens at Night . Variety reports that the psychological thriller, which stars Jennifer Lawrence and Leonardo DiCaprio as a married couple who travel to a European small town to adopt a baby, will feature a cameo from Charli. The project, a co-production between Apple and StudioCanal, does not yet have a release date.
 Despite asking on the MFF track “Camera” if it’s “fuckin’ stupid if I try to be a girl on the screen when I'm turning 34,” Charli has been having a major acting moment. She appeared in multiple movies last year, including Gregg Araki’s I Want Your Sex , Pete Ohs’ Erupja , and Aidan Zamiri’s mockumentary about Charli’s BRAT era, The Moment . She also wrote the soundtrack for Emerald Fennell‘s 2026 film Wuthering Heights (which featured her first collaboration with Cale, “ House ”) and co-wrote music for A24’s Mother Mary .
 Read Anna Gaca on Wuthering Heights and Harry Tafoya on Wuthering Heights: The Album .
